bullets.title: SNOW: Massive F1Q27 beat; Wolfe upgrades to Outperform $235 PT; FY27 guide raised to 31% growth
bullets.body: Snowflake F1Q27 product revenue $1,334M (+34% y/y) beat consensus by ~$70M (5%); NRR improved to 126% from 125%; cRPO $4.60B (+38% y/y). F2Q27 product revenue guided $1,415–1,420M (30% y/y) vs consensus $1,374M. FY27 product revenue raised to $5,840M (+30.6% y/y vs prior 26.6%) and operating margin guide lifted to 13.5% from 12.5%. Wolfe upgraded to Outperform with $235 PT (32% upside from $177.60); KeyBanc $200 PT under review with stock trading ~$227 AH. Company announced $6B multi-year AWS commitment and acquired Natoma MCP platform for AI agent governance.

bullets.title: MRVL: Q1 beat + significantly raised FY27/FY28 guidance on exceptional AI bookings; stock +9%
bullets.body: Marvell Q1 revenue $2.42B (+28% y/y) beat consensus $2.41B; Q2 guide $2.70B (+35% y/y) well above FactSet $2.60B. Management significantly raised FY27 and FY28 revenue outlook (FY28 expected ~$16.5B) driven by exceptional AI-related bookings across 800G/1.6T optics, 51.2T Ethernet switches, and custom XPU solutions. Revenue expected to accelerate each quarter throughout FY27.

bullets.title: CRM: Q1 EPS massive beat ($3.88 vs $3.13); FY EPS guide raised sharply; Q2 revenue guide slightly light
bullets.body: Salesforce Q1 revenue $11.13B beat consensus $11.05B; EPS $3.88 crushed FactSet $3.13. FY27 EPS guidance raised to $14.06–14.12 from prior $13.11–13.19. Agentforce ARR cited at $1B+ (up from $800M). Q2 revenue guided $11.27–11.35B slightly below consensus $11.35B; FCF guide ~4–5% growth implies deceleration. Wolfe rates Outperform with $240 PT (34% upside).

bullets.title: HOOD: Launches AI agentic trading & credit card feature — bulls see incremental revenue story
bullets.body: Robinhood announced a platform feature allowing AI agents (e.g., Anthropic's Claude) to autonomously trade stocks, make credit card purchases, and execute transactions on behalf of customers; derivatives, crypto, and prediction markets planned next. GS TMT desk flagged this as an incremental revenue catalyst alongside credit card expansion.

bullets.title: META: Launches paid subscription tiers for Instagram ($3.99/mo), Facebook ($3.99/mo), WhatsApp ($2.99/mo)
bullets.body: Meta announced subscription services across its three main apps with AI-focused plans coming in future tiers. GS TMT desk describes this as a 'fully incremental story' against AI cost pressures, and stock rose ~3.7% on the day. JPM notes Meta expanding AI chatbot subscriptions to offset AI infrastructure spending pressure.

bullets.title: GOOGL: Morgan Stanley raises bull case to $460; hyperscaler revenue per GW estimates seen as conservative
bullets.body: MS raised GOOGL bull case PT from $425 to $460 (28x '27 bull-case EPS ~$16.50). Analysis argues current AWS/Google Cloud growth forecasts of 35–36%/77–86% in '26/'27 imply $11–14B incremental revenue per GW, suggesting estimates may be conservative. Google Cloud '27 at $11B incremental per GW seen as carrying the most upside potential among hyperscalers.

bullets.title: MU: Market cap crosses $1T threshold; stock up ~9% pre-market on data center demand momentum
bullets.body: Micron broke the $1T market-cap threshold intraday, up ~9% pre-market and gaining 6% to push above Berkshire Hathaway's market cap. Data center demand remains the key driver; one analyst notes current LTA structures provide a structural pricing floor absent in prior memory cycles, tempering read-through to broad DRAM market.

bullets.title: HPE: Q2 revenue $14.41B beat ($13.99B est); raises FY EPS guide to $2.90–$3.10
bullets.body: HPE Q2 revenue $14.41B (+6.3% y/y CC) beat consensus $13.99B; operating margin 7.5% vs Street 6.5%; EPS beat on top of prior guidance. FY26 EPS guide raised to $2.90–3.10 vs prior $2.90–3.20; FCF guidance $2.8–3.0B maintained. Component constraints noted but not materially impacting near-term guide.

bullets.title: NOW: ServiceNow targets $30B revenue by 2030; RaptorDB Pro at $200M sales run-rate
bullets.body: At Jefferies Software/AI conference, ServiceNow highlighted Now Assist with 20 AI specialists, RaptorDB Pro adoption generating $200M in sales over the last four quarters, and Workflow Data Fabric targeting $1B+ revenue potential. The 2030 base case of $30B in revenue implies significant margin and FCF expansion from current levels.

bullets.title: IREN: +13.5% on $1.6B Dell Blackwell purchase agreement for Texas data center
bullets.body: IREN entered a $1.6B purchase agreement with Dell for air-cooled Blackwell systems at its Childress, Texas data center. B. Riley raised targets on IREN (alongside APLD, CORZ, WULF) following an institutional conference; hyperscale HPC names outperforming traditional data center REITs (EQIX, DLR lower) as investors price de-risked energy access.

bullets.title: OKLO: Goldman raises PT to $66 from $63 on DOE plutonium conversion program selection
bullets.body: Goldman Sachs raised OKLO's price target to $66 from $63 following DOE selection for a plutonium conversion program targeting approximately 20 metric tons.

bullets.title: ETSY: Sequential improvement in active buyers for first time in 2+ years; reaffirms FY26 GMV guidance
bullets.body: At Bernstein conference, Etsy management noted first sequential improvement in active buyers in over two years from new and reactivated cohorts; mobile app now 47% of GMV with 40% higher LTV. Depop sale to eBay for $1.2B expected to close after UK approval with proceeds likely directed to buybacks. Full-year 2026 guidance reaffirmed with increased confidence in sustainable GMV growth.

bullets.title: RDDT: JPM hosting corporate access event June 9 with COO, CFO, and IR team in NYC
bullets.body: JP Morgan's Doug Anmuth hosting in-person investor meetings with Reddit COO Jen Wong, CFO Drew Vollero, and IR team on June 9 in New York. Limited spots available.

bullets.title: S&P Index Changes: EPAM exits S&P 500 to S&P 600; SSTK, DAVE, FDXF, FDX impacted effective Jun 1
bullets.body: S&P announced index changes effective June 1: FedEx Freight (FDXF) added to S&P 500 replacing EPAM Systems; FDX remains in S&P 500 and 100. EPAM moves to S&P Small Cap 600 replacing Shutterstock (SSTK, anticipated acquisition close). DAVE replaces American Woodmark (AMWD) in S&P Small Cap 600.

bullets.title: TSM: Raising 3nm chip prices up to 15% in H2 2026
bullets.body: Taiwan Semiconductor is raising 3nm process node pricing by up to 15% in the second half of 2026, according to the StreetAccount Tech sector summary. TSM was one of the few semiconductor outperformers on the day (+2.5%) amid broader semi weakness (-1.4% subsector).

bullets.title: DKNG: Hedgeye hosting discussion on prediction markets and illegal/offshore gaming competitive dynamics
bullets.body: Hedgeye flagged that DKNG and FLUT launched prediction market products a few months ago and that the illegal/offshore gaming sector is robustly competing for the same customer flow. Call scheduled for May 28 to discuss where PM volume is coming from and customer acquisition impact.

bullets.title: EQIX/DLR: Morgan Stanley reiterates Overweight on EQIX ($1,250 PT); raises DLR on record bookings
bullets.body: Equinix raised FY26 revenue and AFFO growth guidance on 1Q bookings strength and AI capacity demand while increasing capex; MS maintains Overweight with $1,250 PT. Digital Realty reported record 0–1MW bookings in 1Q26 with $1B backlog and raised FY26 revenue growth guidance to 10.4%; MS raised DLR estimates and PT. Morgan Stanley hosting in-person group meetings with both companies June 2–3 in NYC.

bullets.title: ACN: UBS maintains Buy ($320 PT); Capgemini 2028 targets signal AI-driven IT services acceleration
bullets.body: UBS cites Capgemini's 2028 targets (4.3–6.5% organic revenue CAGR 2027–28, 130–150bps margin expansion to 12.1–12.3%) as signaling broader IT services inflection that benefits Accenture. UBS expects ACN to deliver +5–7% FY26 revenue growth with +10–30bps operating margin expansion; PT $320 on ~19.5x FY28E EPS. ACN trading at 11% free cash yield, implying market skepticism despite AI transformation tailwinds.

bullets.title: LITE/COHR/AAOI: Increased analyst coverage noted as optical interconnect demand accelerates
bullets.body: A buy-side/desk note flagged increased analyst coverage for LITE, COHR, and AAOI as late additions to the optical interconnect story, driven by 800G/1.6T demand acceleration. Commentary described the coverage expansion as 'a little late to the story, but we'll take it.'

bullets.title: CEG: -4.3% in broader utilities sell-off; GEV targeting TPI Composites blade assets <$50M
bullets.body: Constellation Energy fell 4.3% as utilities broadly declined (index -0.5%) with IPPs VST and TLN also lagging. GEV and Vestas are reportedly targeting TPI Composites blade assets in a fire sale for under $50M. Jefferies highlighted an accelerating data center load story with PPL at ~10GW under ESAs and DUK raising its data center commitment to 7.6GW from 4.5GW.
